crashRatePerMile.note: Tesla: ~250,000 mi / 4 crashes since Jun 2025 launch. Waymo: ~125M driverless mi / 1,267 crashes. Small early sample for Tesla — treat the gap as directional, not definitive.

transparencyNote: Waymo, Zoox, and Avride published detailed, multi-paragraph accounts of every incident from the start. Tesla argued disclosure would let competitors assess its progress, and kept narratives confidential — until May 2026, when it re-filed every report with the redactions removed.
